posts.title: An introduction to RSpec: how to install RSpec, naming convention and basic files structure
posts.description: When you start programming, it's not easy to know what to test, how to test, and why should you test? So let's start with an introduction to RSpec: how to install RSpec, RSpec naming convention and and RSpec files structure.

posts.title: Exploring dependency injection in Ruby
posts.description: Classes depend on each other all the time. But the way you tie those classes together will determine how hard it is to change your code. Dependency injection can help you reduce that coupling and reduce your cost of change.
